text:
Miriam K: Quick sync on the prompt-set compare screen and the approval modal. Dropped a new artboard in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/efgh5678. Main asks: make regressions obvious without being noisy, ensure the approval modal is keyboard + screen-reader friendly, and tighten CTA copy. Screenshot: https://imgur.com/abc. Thoughts? Devin R: Layout: the left diff gutter is cramped when multiple diffs are stacked. Propose a vertical timeline style with small icons for regressed/pass and hover previews. Also the current error red (#e74c3c) fails AA on white; I'll propose two alternatives in figma comments. Ash Patel: For accessibility: each diff card should be focusable with role=button, have aria-pressed=false/true for expanded state, and include visually-hidden summary text like "Regression: test X dropped 14%" so screen reader users can skim. Also add skip links: "Skip to next regression." Miriam K: Copy drafts for modal header/body: "Approve prompt set" -> header id=approve-heading Body: "Promoting this prompt set will apply it to the selected model variants and start a gradual rollout. Add reviewer notes below (optional)." Buttons: primary visual: "Approve & Promote" but primary label attribute should be "Promote" for compactness and shortcut mapping. Secondary: "Request changes". Sam O'Neill: PM take: we want an "Approve with notes" inline action not buried in a menu. Can we add a small expandable textarea under the primary CTA when the user clicks a chevron? Needs to be accessible and not trap focus. Also want a tiny scorecard summary above the fold showing pass rate, regression delta, and top failing case sample. RegressionBot: regression-bot: Alert: prompt-set 89 added 3 regressions, avg quality -9%. Details: https://dash/reports/89 Devin R: UX nit: the scorecard currently lives in the right rail and is easy to miss. Move a condensed scorecard (pass % / regressions) into the modal header or just under the title. Visual suggestion: a small pill with green/red dot + "72% · 3 reg". Ash Patel: Keyboard shortcuts: modal should trap focus while open, escape closes, 'A' triggers primary Promote, 'R' opens Request changes, 'N' focuses notes. Each shortcut must be announced in the tooltip and accessible via the menu for screen readers. Use aria-describedby to point to the shortcut hint element. Miriam K: Decision log: (1) Move condensed scorecard into approval modal header, (2) Primary CTA visual text stays "Approve & Promote" but data-label/aria-label use "Promote" for compact contexts and shortcut binding, (3) Inline notes textarea visible via small chevron under primary CTA (keyboard focusable), (4) Update deletion/regression color to higher-contrast pair (Devin to propose two hexes), (5) each diff card focusable with aria-expanded/aria-controls and a skip link. Sam O'Neill: I'll add these acceptance criteria to INF-1147: visible focus indicator, keyboard shortcuts (A/R/N), scorecard placement, inline notes expand/collapse, and color contrast checks. Adding a subtask to request top-3 failing examples from data for the modal. Ticket: https://jira/redwood/browse/INF-1147 Devin R: CSS + examples I'll add to figma comments and a design tokens PR. Quick CSS for focus visible: ``` .diff-card:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0,95,204,0.18); border-radius: 6px; } ``` Also proposing red alternatives: #b02a37 and #9b2330 (both meet AA on white). Ash Patel: ARIA snippet I'll draft for QA: ```
``` I'll include a screen reader test script and ensure aria-live uses polite updates for progress so we don't spam. Miriam K: Action owners: @Devin R - upload color variants + focus styles + figma tokens; @Ash Patel - ARIA patterns + QA script; @Sam O'Neill - update INF-1147 + request data examples; @Miriam K - update figma copy and prototype the inline notes expansion. Goal: have interactive prototype in staging by next Wednesday. RegressionBot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: 2026-04-02T04:00:00Z to staging (no regressions blocked). Devin R: noted, I'll iterate on the gutter timeline and post mocks. Sam O'Neill: thanks team 44d will sync 11:30am PT tomorrow for handoff.
